'''Fanny Kassel''' (born 1983<ref>{{cite web |access-date=14 March 2024 |language=fr |title=Kassel, Fanny |url=https://www.idref.fr/199580316 |website=IdRef}}<!-- auto-translated from French by Module:CS1 translator --></ref>) is a French [[mathematician]], specializing in the theory of [[Lie group]]s.

== Education and career ==
Kassel entered the [[École normale supérieure (Paris)|École normale supérieure]] in 2003 and received her [[Doctor of Philosophy|PhD]] under the direction of [[Yves Benoist]] at the [[University of Paris-Sud]] in 2009. Her thesis was on "Compact quotients of real or p-adic homogeneous spaces". She then entered the [[CNRS]] and worked at the Paul-Painlevé Laboratory of the [[Lille University of Science and Technology|University of Lille I]] until 2016, when she joined the [[Institut des Hautes Études Scientifiques|IHÉS]] as detached CNRS researcher.<ref>"[https://www.ihes.fr/en/fanny-kassel-joins-ihes-as-a-cnrs-researcher/ Fanny Kassel joins IHES as a CNRS Researcher]", IHES website (20 September 2016).</ref>

== Honors and awards ==
In 2015, she was awarded the CNRS Bronze Medal and an [[European Research Council|ERC]] starting grant the following year.<ref>"[http://www.cnrs.fr/insmi/spip.php?article1148 Médailles d’argent et de bronze 2015]", CNRS website (19 February 2015).</ref> In 2018, she was an invited speaker at the [[International Congress of Mathematicians]] at [[Rio de Janeiro]]; her lecture was on "Geometric structures and representations of discrete groups".<ref>IMU 2018, [http://www.icm2018.org/portal/en/invited-section-lectures-speakers list of invited speakers] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171025163517/http://www.icm2018.org/portal/en/invited-section-lectures-speakers |date=25 October 2017 }} (section 6).</ref> She was named [[Mathematical Sciences Research Institute|MSRI]] Chern Professor for Fall 2020.<ref>{{Cite web|last=MSRI|title=Mathematical Sciences Research Institute|url=http://www.msri.org/|access-date=7 June 2021|website=www.msri.org|archive-date=27 September 2010|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100927124029/http://www.msri.org/|url-status=dead}}</ref> In 2024, she was the recipient of the mathematics medal of the [[French Academy of Sciences]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.ihes.fr/en/fanny-kassel-medal/|title=Fanny Kassel, laureate of the mathematics Medal of the French Academy of Sciences|date=17 October 2024|publisher=IHES|access-date=2024-10-25}}</ref>
